title: Racer Direct Zipf | 512 x 2 GiB | 1 TiB catalog
description: Balanced-config experiment: 512 x 2147483648-byte blobs (1 TiB catalog), seed zipf-balanced-v1, Zipf exponent 0.5, owned-only disk retention (admission disabled), 32 GiB plaintext, 64 GiB ciphertext, and 2 GiB each for dirty and registered buffers. Balanced describes the configuration goal, not measured hit shares. Throughput excludes processes started before 2026-10-09 20:05:50 UTC, the 2 GiB rollout boundary. Wait a full five-minute new-pod window after readiness. Successful payload is not wire traffic or verified goodput. Cache-hit event shares are not client attribution. Disk capacity and usage are physical segment bytes, not effective payload capacity.

panels.title: Total successful client payload (Gbit/s)
panels.description: Successful generic blob operations times exactly 2147483648 bytes (2 GiB). Catalog: 512 blobs (1 TiB), seed zipf-balanced-v1, Zipf exponent 0.5. Includes only completed successes, with or without client hashing. Not wire traffic. The process-start join excludes old 512 MiB and 64 MiB pods, including historical samples before the 2026-10-09 20:05:50 UTC rollout boundary. Missing process metrics or no successful new-pod samples means no data, not zero. Wait a full five-minute window after new-pod readiness. Later mixed sizes invalidate this fixed-config dashboard.

panels.title: Successful payload per discovered Racer node (Gbit/s)
panels.description: Total successful client payload divided by distinct nodes with discovered Racer dataplane scrape targets, including down targets. Removed targets disappear; this is not expected fleet inventory or per-server traffic attribution. No traffic, missing scrapes, and missing discovery must be checked separately.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(racer_loadgen_pulls_total{job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="${namespace}",app_kubernetes_io_name="racer-loadgen",result="success"}[5m]) and on (job, namespace, pod) (process_start_time_seconds{job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="${namespace}",app_kubernetes_io_name="racer-loadgen"} >= 1791576350)) * 2147483648 * 8 / 1e9) / count(group by (node) (up{job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="${namespace}",app_kubernetes_io_name="racer-dataplane"}))

panels.title: Observed cache-hit event mix (not client attribution)
panels.description: Each event rate divided by memory + disk + peer hit event rates. These are shares of observed cache-hit events, not client hit probabilities, byte shares, or lookup hit ratios. Origin fills are excluded. Peer reception and memory/disk serving can count the same page on different nodes; coalesced work is not one event per client read. Idle denominators remain undefined.

panels.title: Average busy logical cores per Racer node
panels.description: Sum of per-CPU non-idle fractions per host, then an equal-weight mean across discovered Racer hosts with CPU samples. Logical cores, not a percentage or total cluster cores. Includes all host workloads and I/O wait, not just Racer. Missing host CPU series are not zero. System-only nodes are excluded by the Racer node join.

targets.legendFormat: Mean busy logical cores per node
targets.expr: avg(sum by (node) (1 - rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[5m])) and on (node) group by (node) (up{job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="${namespace}",app_kubernetes_io_name="racer-dataplane"}))

panels.title: Cluster backing-store disk: physical total vs used
panels.description: Sum of assigned Racer disk segment capacity and reserved aligned record bytes across scraped dataplanes. Both series use physical bytes, not indexed payload or effective payload capacity. Total excludes raw-device guards and unassigned remainder. Used includes record overhead, padding, and reservations until segment recycle; it is not live payload and does not include unused sealed-segment tails. Total minus used is not guaranteed writable payload space. Missing disk scrapes reduce the observed totals; check all 100 nodes separately.
